papers.title: Typed Merge Falsification
papers.current_ceiling: The bounded algebra and falsification calculus are fileable; broad methods significance is withheld.
load_bearing_adverse: C8 is donor-owned, C9 is open and C10 is forbidden in the R2 ledger.
The reported 1,962 trust-store tasks and 46 hybrid obstructions still require submission-commit re-verification.
The E15 cross-trust-system successor has not been attempted.
papers.strongest_remaining_gap: The calculus has not shown that its typed obstructions transfer to independent trust-policy ecosystems with native verifier gold and nontrivial hybrid failures.
papers.decisive_question: Across organization- and implementation-disjoint cosign, TUF and in-toto policy transitions, does the typed merge calculus detect unsafe hybrid merges that donor-complete native checks miss without rejecting valid merges?
papers.maximum_claim_if_supported: Typed merge obstructions form a reusable cross-ecosystem safety calculus for policy and trust-state composition.
papers.hypothesis_or_theorem: For each ecosystem, the calculus should be sound relative to native verification, expose at least one obstruction class not represented by any single donor checker and preserve valid-merge coverage.
papers.population_or_universe: Version-pinned policy/configuration transitions in at least two E15 ecosystems, sampled by a predeclared rule and held out by repository or organization.
papers.unit_of_analysis: One proposed merge between two typed trust/policy states.
historical_only_inputs: The existing 1,962-task/46-obstruction corpus until its binding is independently reverified
design: Reverify the current bounded corpus and hashes before designing the successor.
Create native adapters that emit verifier-derived gold without importing ORION classifications.
Hold out repositories or organizations, not merely files.
Include real historical and planted hybrid-policy failures with provenance-separated labels.
Measure soundness, completeness, minimal certificates and operator cost.
baselines: Strongest donor product found across software-supply-chain policy literature.
primary_endpoints: Unsafe accepted merges, with zero as a noncompensatory endpoint.
Obstruction recall by native failure class.
negative_controls: Type labels permuted while syntax is preserved.
Hybrid obstruction removed but surface conflict retained.
Verifier unavailable or ambiguous, which must yield CANNOT_CHECK.
analysis_plan: Paired merge-level comparison against identical native gold.
Report each ecosystem separately before any pooled claim.
No cross-ecosystem headline unless the same frozen rule succeeds in at least two ecosystems.
papers.power_or_exhaustion_rule: Census all transitions meeting the frozen eligibility rule where feasible; otherwise power on organization-level clusters and freeze the minimum number before labels are opened.
papers.success_gate: Zero unsafe acceptances, materially lower false rejection than fail-closed baselines, and reproducible added obstruction coverage in at least two independent ecosystems.
papers.refutation_gate: Any unsafe acceptance refutes the safety headline; parity with the donor product limits the result to the bounded algebra.
papers.cannot_check_gate: CANNOT_CHECK if native verifier gold, organization-disjoint holdout or the 1,962/46 bounded binding cannot be independently reproduced.
papers.authority_required: Native verifiers plus an independent adapter/checker implementation; security-domain review is required for gold cases not mechanically decidable.

active_lane.collision_rule: No active E15 successor lane was found; do not alter the R2 bounded terminal while designing it.

immediate_safe_actions: Re-run the 1,962-task/46-obstruction binding on an immutable submission candidate.
Build a donor-disposition table for cosign, TUF and in-toto.
Specify organization-disjoint holdout and native-verifier adapters.
forbidden_actions: Do not describe donor-owned C8 as novel.
Do not use self-scored merge labels.
Do not pool ecosystems that use different success semantics without a registered mapping.
papers.journal_bar: A top-tier security/formal-methods paper needs native-verifier soundness, independent ecosystems, minimal counterexamples and a donor-complete baseline.
papers.sibling_boundary: Owns typed merge falsification; responsibility-scoped reuse belongs to ORION-23 and trust custody to ORION-25.
